difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the right adjoint of the functor from modules over a fibre product of rings to pairs of modules, and the proof is a 31-line adjunction computation. It defines the candidate functor by an explicit fibre product of modules cut out by the comparison isomorphism, then verifies the adjunction by computing both sides of the Hom set equality: it rewrites the right hand side using the tensor-restriction adjunction, identifies the resulting fibre product of Hom sets, and exhibits mutually inverse constructions on elements that turn an element of one side into a map out of the first module and back. The elementwise verification of the two inverse constructions is the substance of the proof.
